projects.title: Race Information
projects.description: Race calendars and where to watch them, for nine series in one place.
facts: F1, WEC, WRC, NASCAR Cup, INDYCAR, IMSA, GT World Challenge Europe, SuperRace, Hyundai N Festival
Filter by viewing market (US, KR, global) and by your timezone
Add any race to Google or Apple Calendar; every entry links its official source

projects.title: paper2video
projects.description: Turns an arXiv paper into a narrated, fact-checked explainer video.
facts: Three.js scenes, local Kokoro text-to-speech, ffmpeg

projects.title: Seven models on one p100a
projects.description: Image, video and music models ported to a single Tenstorrent Blackhole p100a card.
facts: FLUX.2 klein, Z-Image-Turbo, HiDream-O1, Qwen-Image-Edit, Wan 2.2, ACE-Step 1.5, DiffRhythm 1.2
A 1024×1024 Z-Image-Turbo image in 7.76 s; a 30-second ACE-Step song in 3.3 s
Apache-2.0 code, weights on Hugging Face

image.alt: Image generated by FLUX.2 klein on a Tenstorrent p100a

projects.title: Big language models on my desk
projects.description: Two Qwen mixture-of-experts models served from the same card, behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
facts: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: every weight on the card, about 82 to 106 tokens/s for one user
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B): card plus host CPU, about 10 to 17 tokens/s
Works as a backend for Claude Code and OpenAI clients

image.alt: A desk with local AI hardware at night

projects.title: Soundstage
projects.description: One studio in front of my image, video and music generators.
facts: Text to image, image to video, lyrics to song, and a storyboard that joins shots into one clip
A small gateway sits in front of three existing services, so none of them had to change
Runs on the models above, on my own machine

image.alt: Soundstage music studio screen with generated tracks

projects.title: AIUsage
projects.description: A menu bar app that shows how much of each AI subscription's limit I have used.
facts: Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Grok and Antigravity, one small bar per account
Turns orange at 70% and red at 90%
Click for every limit and its reset time
